propositions: Phase 3 remediation proposals lack validation of their evidence base, allowing reversals of deliberate project decisions and plausible-but-unreachable harms to reach Phase 4 approval unflagged

The verification phase must add a fifth validity sub-question (harm_reachable) requiring concrete triggering input or state to produce asserted harm, participating in the graded validity fraction with a denominator of 5

The verification phase must detect prior_decision using deterministic queries (git log, git blame, ADR/docs grep, ticket-id grep) and classify results into explicit_justified, explicit_bare, incidental, or none, applying a -0.10 validity penalty only for explicit_justified when remediation does not name changed evidence
Findings with harm_reachable=no must be reclassified from DEFECT to HARDENING and persisted in the Phase-2 audit record, traveling through existing finding_refs to Phase 4 approval for labeling

The remediation phase must split proposers asymmetrically (Proposer A researches OSS patterns, Proposer B researches project record) and trigger a divergence research round on unconverged survivors querying whether each side is explicitly rejected, adopted-and-kept, excluded-at-adoption, or never-considered, mapping high-weight answers on one side to research-resolved and all other outcomes to no-consensus

The approval phase must surface prior_decision records (ticket/ADR/commit, decision, and for reversals the changed evidence) and flag HARDENING items, replacing retired oss-adopted provenance vocabulary with research-resolved and no-consensus
